text: Messages shaped after Model Studio, Fun-ASR-Realtime server events (help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/fun-asr-server-events: task-started, result-generated, task-finished, task-failed examples) and Voxt RemoteASRAliyunStreaming.swift; texts are made up.
